import pandas as pd

# Load Jackdaw data
cpg_df = pd.read_csv('/workspace/JD_AgeRelated_CpG_noMT_Final.csv')
chrom_df = pd.read_csv('/workspace/JD_Chromosome_Length.csv')

print("=== CpG Data Shape ===")
print(cpg_df.shape)
print("\n=== CpG Columns ===")
print(cpg_df.columns.tolist())
print("\n=== CpG Data Head ===")
print(cpg_df.head())

print("\n=== Chromosome Length Data ===")
print(chrom_df.head(10))
print(f"\nTotal chromosomes: {chrom_df.shape[0]}")

# --- Step 1: Filter CpGs with >90% or <10% methylation ---
filtered_cpg = cpg_df[(cpg_df['MethylationPercentage'] > 90) | (cpg_df['MethylationPercentage'] < 10)]
print(f"\n=== Filtered CpGs (>90% or <10% methylation) ===")
print(f"Total rows after filtering: {filtered_cpg.shape[0]}")

# --- Step 2: Get unique age-related CpGs (unique positions) ---
unique_filtered_cpg = filtered_cpg['Pos'].unique()
print(f"Unique filtered CpG positions: {len(unique_filtered_cpg)}")

# --- Step 3: Calculate total genome length (excluding MT as per filename noMT) ---
# Exclude MT chromosome since the CpG data is "noMT"
chrom_noMT = chrom_df[chrom_df['Chromosome'] != 'MT']
total_genome_length = chrom_noMT['Length'].sum()
print(f"\n=== Genome Length (excluding MT) ===")
print(f"Total genome length: {total_genome_length} bp")

# --- Step 4: Calculate genome-wide average chromosomal density ---
density = len(unique_filtered_cpg) / total_genome_length
print(f"\n=== Genome-wide Average Chromosomal Density ===")
print(f"Unique filtered CpGs: {len(unique_filtered_cpg)}")
print(f"Total genome length: {total_genome_length} bp")
print(f"Density (CpGs per bp): {density}")
print(f"Density (scientific notation): {density:.6e}")

# --- Additional breakdown by chromosome ---
print("\n=== Per-Chromosome Breakdown ===")
# Get unique filtered CpGs per chromosome
filtered_cpg_unique = filtered_cpg.drop_duplicates(subset='Pos')
cpg_per_chrom = filtered_cpg_unique.groupby('Chromosome')['Pos'].count().reset_index()
cpg_per_chrom.columns = ['Chromosome', 'UniqueFilteredCpGs']

# Merge with chromosome lengths
chrom_density = cpg_per_chrom.merge(chrom_noMT, on='Chromosome', how='right')
chrom_density['UniqueFilteredCpGs'] = chrom_density['UniqueFilteredCpGs'].fillna(0).astype(int)
chrom_density['Density'] = chrom_density['UniqueFilteredCpGs'] / chrom_density['Length']
chrom_density = chrom_density.sort_values('Chromosome', key=lambda x: x.astype(str).str.replace('W','99').replace('Z','100').astype(float))

print(chrom_density.to_string(index=False))
print(f"\nSum of unique filtered CpGs across chromosomes: {chrom_density['UniqueFilteredCpGs'].sum()}")
print(f"Genome-wide density: {chrom_density['UniqueFilteredCpGs'].sum() / chrom_density['Length'].sum():.6e}")
